changes.reason: Owner-approved 2026-09-28: adopt repositories by their real GitHub names (capitals, dots, underscores), e.g. JensenAbler.github.io. Widening only; clients keep working with cached schemas.

before.description: Exact existing GitHub repository name in the configured account, lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

after.description: Existing GitHub repository name in the configured account, exactly as shown on GitHub: letters, digits, dots, hyphens or underscores, up to 100 characters. Its project ID is the lowercase hyphenated form, e.g. JensenAbler.github.io becomes jensenabler-github-io.
